definition: a hot drink made from cocoa and milk
description: A thick stream of hot brown chocolate pours from a big ladle into a glass cup held out by a hand. On a narrow cobbled street at night in heavy rain, lit by strings of bulbs and blue neon, a barefoot woman in a gold sequin dress and a stained apron stands on a wooden cart, dips the ladle into steaming metal pots and lifts it high to pour again. All around, a crowd of people in dark raincoats and hoods hold up cups to be filled, and a man in an apron serves at the other side.

de.answer: Sie gießt heiße Schokolade in eine Tasse.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está vertiendo chocolate caliente en una taza.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle verse du chocolat chaud dans une tasse.
